summary_md: **Tatra Labs ([@TatraLabs](https://x.com/TatraLabs/status/2115262297178591691))** describes Google Research's *Language Models Need Sleep*: while awake the model stores information in fast short-term memory; during sleep it consolidates into new weights, then 'dreams' by deliberately routing to the wrong MoE experts to force novel combinations.
